results.snippet: Former outfielder present for all three Brewers' postseason walk-off hits celebrates team's first World Series in 44 years. Former Major League outfielder Niger Morgan (46), who briefly played for the KBO League’s Hanwha Eagles, has emerged as Milwaukee’s “victory fairy” and cheered for their World Series triumph.
